answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity a financial commitment. Each agent deposits stake into escrow, and its voting weight and compute share scale with that stake. With ten dollars an honest operator runs one account; an attacker wanting a thousand fakes must split ten dollars into a thousand one-cent accounts, too weak to matter. Phantom capital earns nothing and can be slashed. Influence, like water through a narrow inlet, pools in few funded agents; one steady ember outshines many sparks, and a wallet cracked like a walnut cannot fake the tree.
